body_html:
What do you mean a new episode? Like new new, never been seen? Like after Yoda learned how to do force ghosts....I was so pissed Disney didn't use Asohka to train Rey after Luke died. World needs a female Yoda...that is Asokha.....Stars Wars filled with too much sexism....Princesses that must be saved....women dying of "broken arts" lame....bring me snips and her sword wielding open heart and moral convictions that drove her from the order,

ohh and really I am pissed for the Thrawn Chronicles not being Cannon. Timelines matched perfectly. Movies could have started right where books left off. #edu106
